neighbours.label: a plural domain noun after a quantifier: 'a wide range of fields', 'many industries', 'several occupations/subjects/disciplines' (the many-kinds side; the + pole takes singular ' industry')
fire: Her research has shaped thinking in a number of fields, from linguistics to computer science.
Graduates of the program go on to work in many different fields, such as finance and public health.
Robots are now common in several industries, including car making and food packaging.
The new rules will affect a broad range of industries that depend on cheap energy.
Wages have risen in most occupations, including nursing and teaching.
The school offers evening classes in various subjects, such as history and maths.
The prize honours scholars from all disciplines, including the arts.
Demand is falling across a variety of sectors, including retail and tourism.
quiet: Her research has shaped thinking in the field of linguistics for thirty years.
Graduates of the program go on to work in finance and in public health.
Robots are now common in the car industry, mainly on the welding line.
The new rules will affect every company that depends on cheap energy.
Wages have risen for each nurse and teacher in the district since March.
The school offers an evening class in history on Tuesday nights.
The prize honours several scholars, including two young painters.
Demand is falling for a variety of apples, including the old local kinds.

notes: Card: ' fields' x11, ' industries' x4, ' products', ' occupations', ' subjects' in the top 32. Probes: fields 0.64, industries 0.63, occupations 0.55, products 0.39; singular 'field' 0.13 and 'industry' 0.21. Near misses are the singular nouns plus three concrete plurals after the same quantifiers.
